chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 475 – Li Huowang Hunts a Spirit Perversion for 430 Pills
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang needs 400 Yang-Life Pills to save Bai Lingmiao’s sight. He takes a deadly gamble on a Spirit Perversion bounty — a parasitic horror of unpredictable danger.
og_description: Li Huowang accepts the highest-paying bounty in the Office: a parasitic horror called Spirit Perversion. The reward is huge. The risk is unknown.
twitter_title: Li Huowang goes bounty hunting for a Spirit Perversion
twitter_description: Broke and desperate, Li Huowang picks the most dangerous job on the board — a Spirit Perversion. But the first two locations are empty, and Bai Lingmiao is going blind.

lore_anchors.definition: A parasitic evil entity whose form and power depend entirely on what it latches onto; can be trivial (on a grass blade) or catastrophic (on a demon).
Pills condensed from refined lifespan, used as a supernatural currency in the Dao-Twisted World for purchasing rare artifacts and cures.
A purer grade of refined lifespan, untainted by sin or karma, making it more valuable for powerful rituals and healing.
The Supervisory Heavenly Office’s vault of confiscated or stored supernatural artifacts; items are bought with Yang-Life Pills at steep prices.
A government-sponsored supernatural police force that operates like a cold, bureaucratic corporation; maintains order by managing threats and brokering bounties.
The highest-ranking members of the Zuowandao sect, forming an interconnected network; killing one can bring retaliation from the rest.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang refuse to recruit help for the Spirit Perversion hunt?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He wants to keep all four hundred and thirty Yang-Life Pills for himself. Any partner would mean splitting the reward, which would leave him short of the price for the relic.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang avoid the Zuowandao bounties despite the high pay?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He’s learned that the Four Joys and Three Yuans are interconnected like sticky plasters. Killing one brings more trouble. He wants a clean job with a defined end.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does Bai Lingmiao’s bamboo tapping mean?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is blind. The bamboo pole is her way of navigating the world. Her careful washing of the clothes Li Huowang bought her is a quiet, tragic act of clinging to normalcy.
